# VERITAS-AI v0.2.0

This public pre-release adds a guided reviewer demonstration to the executable laboratory proof of concept. Its evidence remains consistent with TRL 3.

The Streamlit application now runs the real pipeline from data generation to signed-ledger verification. It reports completed work as it happens, pauses for an operator acknowledgement, evaluates two ordered recovery windows, and then signs six assurance events. A separate Signed Evidence Review verifies the ledger before showing decisions, thresholds, feature drift, labelled and unlabelled evidence, recovery checks, and artifact hashes.

The portable route generates a safe PCAP and deterministic Zeek-format records. Reviewers may instead select the digest-pinned Docker route to process the PCAP through Zeek. Compact evidence and full run archives are generated only after verification. The safe tamper test changes a temporary ledger copy and confirms that verification fails without changing the canonical ledger.

The release also preserves valid version 1.0 evidence produced by v0.1.0. New evidence uses schema version 1.1.0.

The software is not an operational security product. It has not been evaluated with a security end user, an external adoption partner, production traffic, or a representative operational environment. It does not demonstrate TRL 6, certification, or operational effectiveness.
